conviction_note: Q3 revenue should land near the company's guided midpoint, slightly above a consensus that sits in the lower half of the range, so the print turns on the Q4 guide; the name fell 4-7% on four of its last five guides that came in under consensus, but the stock already lost 25.3% on 2026-11-12 on unconfirmed 'softer guidance' chatter, which leaves a slight positive lean (p_up 53) on a large two-sided move (abs 9%); the findings sum (+1.0) and the scaled number (+0.54) agree in sign and the gap is the uncertainty about whether the Nov-12 rumour was informed.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue: company guide RMB2.41-2.50bn (+11.4% to +15.6% YoY on Q3 2025 RMB2,163.3m), from the Q2 release (https://finsee.ai/earnings/bz/2026/q2/en/ ; https://finviz.com/news/385147/kanzhun-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results). Street: revenue $362.7M and EPS $0.27 (Earnings Whispers, 2026-11-18, https://finviz.com/news/424951/kanzhuns-pricing-pivot-faces-first-real-test-as-shares-slide-toward-range-lows), which it puts in the lower half of the guide converted at about $358.5-371.9M; Benzinga shows about $363.2M, and one later snapshot shows $365.9M (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/BZ/earnings-forecasts). The two revenue sources roughly agree. The Q4 2026 revenue consensus of about $346.5M (~RMB2.33-2.37bn, roughly +12-14% on Q4 2025's RMB2,078.5m) has ONE source (Benzinga), so guidance findings are capped small. The sweep's EPS row of -$0.02 is broken; the bar is $0.27.
positioning_check: Short interest is about 30.2M shares, about 8% of float, 6.65 days to cover, against 28.2M the prior month (stockanalysis.com, page updated 2026-11-24, settlement date not shown, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/bz/statistics/). Finviz shows 7.7% short float and a 4.21 short ratio (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=BZ, read 2026-11-24). CurvedTrading had 24.1M shares and 7.4 days at the 2026-08-14 settlement (search snippet; the page returned 403). So shorts are building but the name is not a crowded short (well below the 18-23% that squeezed before). The baseline has no 25d skew (null). Put/call open interest is 0.23, so open interest is call-heavy. Front-expiry ATM IV is 53.5%, and the straddle is 9.96% over 24 days. The baseline's event-implied move of 0.0 is an artefact of 95% 20-day realised vol inflated by the -25.3% day on 2026-11-12; a rough event variance from IV against ordinary-day vol gives about a 6-7% one-sigma event move. Tape: -24.6% over 20 days, -4.1% over 5 days, 0.5% above the 52-week low, 43.7% below the high. Analysts: 11 Buy and 2 Hold, mean target about $19.97.

findings.finding: BZ fell 25.3% on 2026-11-12 (about 7.9M shares, nearly 2x normal volume) with no company filing or announcement. Coverage attributes the fall to 'market chatter pointing to softer revenue guidance' plus a China-tech/AI selloff (Golden Dragon index -2-3%, BABA -7%, GDS -11%). The stock is now $12.56, 0.5% above its 52-week low, so a sub-consensus Q4 guide is already partly in the price. A Q4 guide in line with the roughly +12-14% YoY consensus (~$346.5M) would clear a bar that has moved down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On Aug 26, 2026, when growth re-accelerated from a beaten-down level, the stock rose about 16-17% (https://www.ibtimes.com.au/kanzhun-q2-earnings-ai-growth-1874617). There is no prior case of a pre-print rumour crash to compare against.
findings.why_not_priced: This IS a pricing event, so the claim is only about where the bar now sits. If the market believed in-line guidance was likely, the stock would not sit at its 52-week low with EV near $2.6bn (about 2x revenue, forward P/E about 9.4), and the move to range lows would not have continued after Nov 12 (-4.1% over 5 days). The 10jqka write-up attributes the fall to sector and AI-jobs sentiment, not to any company number, which is what makes a guide merely in line able to surprise.
findings.independence: https://stock.10jqka.com.cn/20261113/c681791793.shtml (2026-11-13) attributes the fall to AI-tech weakness, fear of AI cutting hiring, and post-dividend reallocation, with no company-specific news. https://www.caiwennews.com/article/1698741.shtml (2026-11-12) has BZ -20.45% intraday inside a >3% Golden Dragon drop. Caveat: if the chatter came from informed channel checks, this finding is wrong-signed, which is why it is sized small.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue is likely to print around the company's RMB2.455bn guide midpoint (+13.5% YoY). That is about 0.5-0.8% above the $362.7M consensus, which Earnings Whispers places in the lower half of the guide. In Q2, Kanzhun printed RMB2,398.6m against a RMB2.38-2.42bn guide (essentially the midpoint). Management also said Q3 margins would stay near Q2's record 43.8% adjusted operating margin, with the FY2026 adjusted operating margin slightly up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: BZ has repeatedly fallen 4-7% on prints where the reported quarter beat or matched (Nov 2025: Q3 beat, -6.7% premarket on the Q4 guide). The reported quarter has not moved this stock on its own.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the item lands inside the company's own guided range, so it is sized near zero. The only unpriced part is that consensus sits below the guide midpoint. A street that expected the midpoint would carry about $365M or more, not $362.7M.
findings.independence: The Q2 guide (RMB2.38-2.42bn) against the actual (RMB2,398.6m) is from https://finviz.com/news/355852/kanzhun-limited-announces-first-quarter-2026-financial-results and https://finviz.com/news/385147/kanzhun-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results. The margin commentary is from https://quartr.com/events/kanzhun-bz-q2-2026_F3l2v6VV.

findings.finding: The guide is the line BZ trades on, and management has guided below consensus on four of the last five prints. Each time the stock fell 4-7% even when the quarter beat: Q2-25 guide in May 2025 (-7%), Q3-25 guide in Aug 2025 (-5%), Q4-25 guide of RMB2.05-2.07bn below the RMB2.07bn FactSet consensus in Nov 2025 (-6.7%), and Q1-26 guide of +6.6-8.4% in Mar 2026 (-4 to -6%). The Q4 2026 comp is tough: Q4 2025 grew 14.0%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide below consensus: -7% (May 2025), -5% (Aug 2025), -6.7% (Nov 2025), -4 to -6% (Mar 2026). Guide or growth acceleration: +16-17% (Aug 2026).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced by the Nov 12 crash (finding 1). What is not priced is management's habit of guiding conservatively, set against a single-source Q4 consensus (~$346.5M, about +12-14%) that may still sit above where a conservative Q4 guide lands. If the market fully expected a conservative guide, the sell-side consensus would already have been cut below the +11-12% low end of the Q3 guide's growth rate.
findings.independence: Mar 2026 Q1 guide below expectations: https://www.itiger.com/hans/news/1135804867 and https://rallies.ai/news/kanzhun-ads-fall-as-market-weighs-q4-results-cautious-q1-revenue-guide. May/Aug 2025: https://www.itiger.com/news/1198586624 and https://www.itiger.com/news/1134610496. These are separate prints, though several reports come from the same publisher (Tiger Stock Track). The Q4 consensus is single-source (Benzinga), so the size is capped.

findings.finding: The buyback has run down: more than US$300M of the US$400M authorization (through 2027-08-28) was used in 2026 by the September release, and on-market repurchase press updates found end in early July 2026. Meanwhile shares outstanding fell 2.37% QoQ, net cash is about $3.09bn against a $5.63bn market cap, and the stock is at a 52-week low. A new or enlarged authorization alongside the Q3 print is plausible, under the 3-year policy of returning at least 50% of prior-year adjusted NI.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Mar 2026: the buyback was raised to $400M alongside a weak Q1 guide, and the stock still fell 4-6%. Aug 2026: a $230M dividend came with the Q2 beat and the stock rose 16%. Capital return has not by itself overridden the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference: no company statement says a new authorization is coming. If the market expected an enlarged buyback, a stock with 55% of its market cap in net cash would not sit at its 52-week low.
findings.independence: Share count -2.37% QoQ and cash of $3.09bn are from https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/bz/statistics/ (2026-11-24). The last repurchase update found (over RMB2.06bn in H1 2026) is from https://finviz.com/news/365250/boss-zhipins-ongoing-share-repurchases-reach-over-rmb206-billion-in-1h2026. The absence of later updates is a search result, not a document.

findings.finding: China's labour series do not show a Q3/Q4 hiring collapse. October urban surveyed unemployment was 5.1% (from 5.2%), youth (16-24 ex-students) unemployment was 17.2% against 17.3% a year earlier, and Q3 averaged 5.2%, flat YoY, with NBS citing strong IT/software hiring. Zhaopin's Q3 2026 talent-market report shows job postings growing in new industries (elder care +43.9%, new materials +14.8%, big data +10.2%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None that is company-specific; macro series have not been tied to BZ print reactions in sources found.
findings.why_not_priced: These are public macro series, so likely priced. They are filed only as a small counterweight to the 'AI kills hiring' narrative behind the Nov 12 selloff; if that narrative reflected real data, the youth and urban series would be deteriorating YoY.
findings.independence: Proxy, not company-confirmed. October youth rate: https://www.scmp.com/economy/economic-indicators/article/3374856/chinas-youth-unemployment-rate-down-tide-fresh-graduates-continues-ebb (Nov 2026). Zhaopin Q3 report: https://stock.10jqka.com.cn/20261015/c680703685.shtml.

findings.finding: Peer read-through on the AI de-rating. Recruit (Indeed) raised its FY HR Technology forecast on 2026-11-11 with HR Tech revenue +27.5% YoY, yet its shares fell 1.4% that day and 5.6% on Nov 12. SEEK is down about 45% YoY, with its CEO citing AI uncertainty. Recruitment platforms are being de-rated on an AI-replaces-hiring narrative that a good print has not reversed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The peer itself (Recruit) sold a raised guide in the same week. BZ sold beats in 2025 (see finding 3).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is the narrative behind the selloff. It is filed because it bounds the upside, since a clean guide may not be rewarded while the sector is de-rating.
findings.independence: Same document as finding 1's independence source. It is a different claim (the peer reaction function, not BZ's bar), but it shares the document.

findings.finding: Shorts are building into the print. Short interest is about 30.2M shares (about 8% of float, 6.65 days to cover), up from about 28.2M the prior month and about 24.1M at the Aug 14 settlement, while option open interest is call-heavy (put/call OI 0.23).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not crowded enough to have a squeeze history. The Aug 2026 print (+16-17%) came off a depressed base.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public. The unpriced part is only that about 4-7 days of covering would add to any relief move on an in-line guide; at about 8% of float this is a modest amplifier, not a mechanism by itself.
findings.independence: Finviz shows 7.7% short float and a 4.21 short ratio (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=BZ). CurvedTrading had 24.1M shares and 7.4 days at Aug 14 (search snippet, page 403).

baseline_tension: The baseline has no skew and an event-implied move broken by inflated realised vol. The -24.6% 20-day run-up and the call-heavy open interest mean the downside case (a soft guide) is already substantially in the price. The slight positive lean therefore leans against the momentum and away from the free control (-run_up_20d, which would say long), not against an option-market statement. The lean is held near 50 because this name has sold four of its last five guides.
lessons_applied: Section 5 ('no filing is not a cause'; an unexplained drawdown is worth 0): finding 1 rests partly on the drawdown having no company-specific trigger. It is kept because two sources name a cause (chatter about a soft guide plus the sector/AI selloff) and BZ is not a microcap, but it is cut from +1.5 to +1.0.
Section 6 (findings inside the guided range move toward 0): finding 2 (Q3 at the guide midpoint) is cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Section 6 (a single-source bar caps guidance findings): the Q4 consensus has one source, so finding 3 is cut from -1.5 to -1.2.
Section 5 (proxies are filed small): finding 5 (macro labour series) is cut from +0.3 to +0.2, and finding 4 (buyback top-up, an inference) from +0.8 to +0.6.
Section 7 (positioning is the thing to beat): short interest was looked up. At about 8% of float it is not crowded, so finding 7 is trimmed from +0.5 to +0.4.
Section 1 (the reaction function vetoes the fundamental read): p_up moves from 54 to 53. The reported-quarter beat (print_vs_bar +0.6) is unchanged.
